capabilities: collect tagged checklist items from all notes into one sidebar
check off tasks and sync completion back to the source Markdown file
filter tasks by tag, file pattern, folder, and search text
group and sort tasks by tag, page, folder, or file times
delegate completion dates and recurring tasks to the Tasks plugin
extras: Tasks integration requires Tasks 7.2 or later; custom-status filtering is not supported.
problem: Tasks scattered across many notes have no single place to view and complete them, so users must search file by file.

relations.evidence: Enable Complete with Tasks to use the Tasks plugin for completion dates and recurring tasks.

summary: Sidebar view that consolidates checklist items tagged across vault notes, lets you check them off and jump to the source line.
